tool: gpt-image-2 through tools/buildings/concept.sh, prompt from tools/icons/icons.py
prompt:
Use case: one game icon for Under the Canopy, a Warcraft III: Reforged-like RTS of insect armies on the forest floor. The game shows it small (about 56 to 72 pixels) on its HUD command card, so it must read instantly at that size.
THE ICON FAMILY (every icon in the game follows it): a square, full-bleed, hand-painted stylised 3D illustration in the manner of Warcraft III: Reforged unit and ability icons. ONE subject, big in the frame, with chunky, simple, bold forms, crisp clean edges, glossy materials with clear edge highlights, saturated but controlled colour. Strong value contrast: the subject is clearly brighter and more saturated than its background, and a bright rim light separates its silhouette. Light: a warm key light from the upper left and a cool blue-violet rim light from behind on the right. The background is dark, simple and soft, never scenery: a smoky vignette that falls to near-black in the corners. Keep the bottom-right corner calm and dark (the game draws a hotkey letter there). NO text, letters, numbers, runes, UI, frame, border or bevel (the game draws the frame). No noise, grain, sparkle, specks or tiny clutter; few, large, clear shapes.
ICON TYPE: BUILDING PORTRAIT. The whole building seen from the front-left at about 35 degrees from above, as in the reference, centred and filling about 90% of the frame's width, slightly cropped at the bottom. No ground, dirt, base plate or scenery around it: it stands on darkness with a soft dark shadow. Background: dark charcoal with a soft warm amber glow behind the building's top.
FACTION: ANTS, a biological army of the forest. Glossy burnt-rust-orange chitin, ivory mandible tusks, big black eyes; everything they carry is grown: leaf cloaks and hoods, bark-rimmed leaf shields, bone and thorn blades, silk nets, seed pods. The faction's colour is deep maple-leaf red (cloaks, hoods, shields). Substance, the forest's magic, has changed their bodies: where it shows, it is a faint blue-violet glow in veins and sap, never green. Match the reference board's materials and palette.
REFERENCES: the first image is the building as it is in the game (keep its shape); the others are approved icons of the same family: match their rendering, lighting, background and framing, but not their subject.
THE SUBJECT: the QUEENSGUARD HALL, the ants' main hall: a great long hall of dark timber and bark under a sweeping roof of overlapping deep red maple leaves, huge ivory tusks curving up from its ridge and flanking the arched door.
